insight: Reached a ~$7B valuation in 2021 (backed by Sequoia and Coatue) and crossed ~$500M ARR in 2024.
name: Attentive
tagline: AI-powered SMS and email marketing for enterprise consumer brands.
description: Attentive is a conversational marketing platform centered on SMS, plus email, for consumer brands. Attentive AI (launched 2023) generates and optimizes messages, builds audiences, and personalizes sends, with 100+ integrations into commerce and data systems. It is an enterprise-grade platform used by large retailers to drive revenue from text and email programs.
edge: SMS-first at enterprise scale — Attentive AI writes, targets, and optimizes text and email campaigns for large consumer brands.
cons: AI is part of a broader suite
